description: TCP-relay-free remote desktop: Cloudflare Worker relay + Windows FFmpeg/NVENC agent + WebCodecs browser viewer

ACCOUNT_SECRET.description: A random string that signs login cookies for **your** ClankerDesk. Generate your own (for example run `node -e "console.log(require('crypto').randomBytes(32).toString('hex'))"`) and paste it here. Do not reuse the example value -- anyone who knows it can forge a login for any account on this instance. Leave it blank and ClankerDesk still runs, but Sign up / Log in stay switched off.
